content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text resolves a challenge by comparing the challenger's seed/loins chain and the defender's chain, so it is a chain-against-chain collision governed by K-C.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"UNDERDETERMINED -- the challenger's seed/loins chain is footed but does not name Joseph as the begetter; the defender's chain is footed but rests on the woman-route inference.","rule_words":"A link is judged by its support, never by whether any verse, or the chain as a whole, states it word for word; and a verse whose words leave the question open decides nothing by itself. ... the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires","room":"by footing, never verse by verse -- (1) assess each chain's overall support; (2) require an individual verse to state the link in its own words","why":"The judge calls a footed chain underdetermined because it does not name Joseph and treats the other as merely inferential, thereby using explicit verse wording instead of weighing chain footing as K-C requires."}
